name: Golang
test_cmd: go test -v -race -coverprofile=/out/coverage.raw ./... && mod=$(go list -m) && find . -name '*.go' -not -path './vendor/*' -exec awk 'FNR==1{d=0} d{next} {sub(/\r$/,"")} /^package[ \t]/{d=1;next} /^\/\/ Code generated .* DO NOT EDIT\.$/{print FILENAME;d=1}' {} + | sed "s|^\./|$mod/|" | sort > /out/coverage.generated && : > /out/coverage.excluded && awk 'FILENAME==ARGV[1]{g[$0]=1;next} FNR==1{print;next} {f=$0;sub(/:[0-9]+\.[0-9]+,[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ [0-9]+ [0-9]+$/,"",f)} f ~ /\.pb\.go$/ || (f in g){if(!(f in x)){x[f]=1;print f >> "/out/coverage.excluded"};next} {print}' /out/coverage.generated /out/coverage.raw > /out/coverage.out && echo '=== COBERTURA: ARCHIVOS GENERADOS EXCLUIDOS ===' && sort /out/coverage.excluded && echo '=== COBERTURA: TOTAL SIN CODIGO GENERADO ===' && go tool cover -func=/out/coverage.out
lint_cmd: out=$(gofmt -l . | grep -v '\.pb\.go' | grep -v 'vesselv1'); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "=== GOFMT UNFORMATTED ==="; echo "$out"; fi; go vet ./...; [ -z "$out" ]
